title: Thangigagi
desc: Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.

title: Damarukam
desc: After a demon born from darkness plans to take over the world, a man decides to take matters into his hands and fight to save his beloved.

title: Habba
desc: A dark secret from Seetha's past keeps her from marrying Ram, her lover. Luckily for the couple, Ram's brothers are determined to get them back together.

title: Ondagona Baa
desc: Raghu comes to his paternal village to attend his grandfather's diamond jubilee function. He finds out that due to his uncle, his family was separated, and tries to fix things.
